title: 领导的一般理论
label: 艺术示意
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: management course chapter-opening artwork. Subject: a beautifully crafted open architectural model of a shared civic workshop, with an experienced adult coordinator listening to a small diverse team gathered around a physical pavilion prototype; different expertise contributes to a common direction, leadership communicated through attention and coordination rather than rank. Style: museum-quality contemporary editorial art combining tactile miniature architecture with natural human detail, sophisticated academic art-book finish. Composition: wide 16:10, focal group and model occupy the right two thirds, softly lit warm ivory negative space on the left for native webpage title. Palette: warm white, deep ink, muted teal, restrained brass accents. Lighting: gentle oblique daylight with dimensional material textures. Source basis: chapter 9 leadership, influence and coordinated collective action; this is a conceptual teaching scene, not a real company or historical event. Avoid all text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, charts, arrows, corporate stock-photo posing, giant leader figures, duplicated limbs or surreal hands. One independent image only.

review.scope: individual visual inspection of generated image or numbered contact sheet
checks: no fabricated statistical evidence or corporate attribution
no obvious distracting anatomical or material defects
